content.text: In this lesson, you will learn about the word 'Sa' and how to use it with personal pronouns.
SA is a preposition that can mean to, at, in, for, or on, depending on the context.

list.item: Nag-aaral ako sa University of California.: [I am studying AT University of California.]
Nagtatrabaho ako SA ospital.: [I work AT the hospital.]
Pupunta ako sa California bukas: [I will go TO California tomorrow.]
Pupunta ako sa market.: [I am going TO the market.]

content.text: 3. SA marks the beneficiary of an action or object. It is equivalent to the English "for" phrase in the context of doing something for someone/something.

list.item: Bibili ako ng pagkain para sa nanay ko: [I will buy food FOR my mom.]
Magluluto ako para sa asawa ko.: [I will cook FOR my spouse.]

content.text: 4. SA marks a future tense expressed as a specific day/date/season.

list.item: Magtatrabaho ako sa Lunes.: [I will work on Monday.]
Magcecelebrate kami ng birthday ni Ella sa Abril 8.: [We will celebrate Ella's birthday on April 8.]

content.text: You can replace the very first vowel of a possessive pronoun with 'sa':

list.item: (sa) akin: mine
(sa) iyo: yours
(sa) kanya: hers/his
(sa) amin: ours (excluding you)
(sa) atin: ours (including you)
(sa) inyo: you (plural)
(sa) kanila: theirs
Regalo para sa akin. (for me)
Regalo para sa iyo. (for you)
Regalo para sa kanya. (for his/her)
Regalo para sa amin. (for us - exclusive)
Regalo para sa atin. (for us - inclusive)
Regalo para sa inyo. (for you - plural)
Regalo para sa kanila. (for them)

content.text: "KAY" and "KINA" are used to express for whom an action is done, specifically for names:

list.item: Bibili ako ng pagkain para kay Lisa.: [I will buy food for Lisa.]
Magluluto ako para kina Lisa at Aaron.: [I will cook for Lisa and Aaron.]

question.text: What does "Pupunta ako sa market" mean?

answers.answer: I am going to the market

question.text: What is the correct translation for "Gift for me" in Tagalog?
What does "Bibili ako ng regalo para sa kanya" mean?

answers.answer: I will buy a gift for him/her
I will buy food for Lisa
